quote: Why do we build walls around breaking hearts? When love was always meant to shatter us open. We guard our deepest secrets from the dark, forgetting the soil needs shadow to grow. Even the brightest stars must eventually burn out, leaving behind only dust and quiet memory. So why do we fear the heavy ache? When breaking apart is how we finally learn to heal.
